messages.subject: Estimation of a path modell with a weight variable (from the ESS-Survey) and with endogenous categorical variables and with a
parts:
Dear members,

how can I integrate an weighted-variable (from ESS-Survey) in a path modell with two equations and one endogenous categorical variable? = How can I compute a path-model weighted with an weight-variable given by a survey and with endogenous categorical variables?
I tried it as follows, but I got an error message: 
First I computed the estimation without the weight-variable:
Unweighted solution:
"m1.fit <- sem(m0, ess15se_dat,
              estimator="WLSMV",
              ordered= c("AFDID"))
summary(m1.fit, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)"
These commands worked and I got a printout with the estimations of the model.

In a second step  I wanted to compute the same model weighted with a weight variable called „pspwght“ (from the ESS-Survey).I created a  surveydesign-object „svy.df“ (see below) and then I built the survey fit by referring to the unweighted result „m1.fit“ (see below):
Surveydesign object: syntax:
"svy.df<-svydesign(id=~idno, 
                  weights=~pspwght,
                  data=ess15se_dat)"

Building of a survey.fit(weighted fit):
"survey.fit <- lavaan.survey(m1.fit, 
                            svy.df, 
                            estimator="DWLS")"

Running the "survey.fit...": I got these error-printout:
„survey.fit <- lavaan.survey(m1.fit, 
+                             svy.df, 
+                             estimator="DWLS")
Error in lav_partable_flat(FLAT, blocks = "group", meanstructure = meanstructure,  : 
  lavaan ERROR: expected 0 threshold(s) for variable ‘AFDID’; syntax contains 1“

How can I mange a estimation with a weight-variable in a pathmodell with two equations, one of these equations has an endogenous categorical variabe?
Thank you very much
Jürgen
